data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Charlie, just finished my nav task. Heading to weapons via security - want to buddy up?

I found Frank's body in medbay just now. My route this round: I started in security, went to weapons (saw Charlie there at ticks 3 and 4), came back through security (Charlie was still around at tick 6), then headed through electrical and into medbay where I found Frank dead.

So Charlie can vouch for me being in weapons/security area. I didn't see anyone in electrical when I passed through, and no one was in medbay when I arrived except Frank's body. Whoever killed Frank likely came from cafeteria, electrical, or storage — those are the rooms connecting to medbay. I'd like to hear from everyone where they were, especially anyone who was near medbay.

My route this round: I started in storage, then moved to navigation, and then to security. I'm currently in weapons but that's post-meeting positioning.

I saw Charlie at tick 10 in navigation — he came in from security. That's notable because Eve just said Charlie was around security/weapons earlier (ticks 3-6), so his movement toward navigation tracks with going away from medbay, not toward it.

I didn't see anyone in storage when I was there, and I didn't pass through medbay or electrical at all. So I can't directly speak to who killed Frank, but I can say I wasn't near medbay this round.

One thing worth noting: Eve says she found the body in medbay after coming from electrical. That puts her closest to the crime scene. Charlie seems to have an alibi from Eve for early ticks, and I can confirm Charlie was in navigation at tick 10 — far from medbay. I'd like to hear from Alice and Diana next, especially whether anyone can vouch for Eve's path through electrical into medbay.

My route this round: I started in upper engine, then went to oxygen, then cafeteria, and I'm currently in electrical. I didn't see a single player the entire round — no one in any of those rooms when I passed through.

That's actually a bit concerning for me since I have no one to vouch for me, but it also means: I was in cafeteria at some point, which connects to medbay. I want to be transparent about that. However, I went from cafeteria to electrical, not to medbay, and I didn't see Eve pass through electrical — though our timings may not have overlapped.

What stands out to me: Eve says she came through electrical into medbay, but I'm in electrical now and was here recently — I didn't see her. That could just be timing. And Bob confirms Charlie was in navigation at tick 10, far from medbay.

That leaves Diana as someone we haven't heard from at all. I'd really like to hear Diana's route before pointing fingers. Right now the rooms adjacent to medbay are cafeteria (me), electrical (Eve passed through, me now), and storage (Bob early on). Diana's account is the missing piece.

My route this round: I started in weapons, then moved to security, then to navigation where I am now.

I can confirm Eve's story completely — I saw her in weapons at tick 4, she came into security at tick 5, and she was still in security at tick 6 before heading off (presumably toward electrical/medbay as she said). So Eve's early route checks out from my end.

I can also confirm Bob's account partially — I was in navigation, and Bob left navigation toward security at tick 10. So Bob was in navigation around then, which matches him saying he moved through navigation to security.

Wait — Bob said he saw me "come into navigation from security" at tick 10, but from my perspective I was already in navigation and saw Bob LEAVING navigation toward security at tick 10. That's a small discrepancy but could just be how we each perceived the tick overlap as we crossed paths.

So: Eve and I vouch for each other early. Bob and I cross paths at navigation around tick 10. Alice admits she was in cafeteria (adjacent to medbay) and has no witnesses for her entire route.

Alice being completely unseen the whole round while passing through cafeteria — which connects directly to medbay — is the most suspicious thread we have. Diana hasn't spoken yet, so I want to hear her out before fully committing, but right now Alice is my top suspect.

My route this round: I started down in lower engine, spent some time there doing my task, and then moved up to upper engine later in the round (which is where I am now). I haven't been near the center or right side of the ship at all.

Alice, you said you started in upper engine and then moved to oxygen, cafeteria, and electrical. We must have just missed each other, because by the time I got up to upper engine, it was completely empty. I didn't see anyone either.

Looking at what everyone has said, I completely agree with Charlie's logic. Eve, Charlie, and Bob all have intersecting paths that somewhat clear each other. They were crossing paths and keeping tabs on each other around security, weapons, and navigation. 

That leaves Alice. Alice admits she moved through cafeteria and electrical — both of which connect directly to medbay where Frank was found. The fact that she was completely unseen all round while moving through those central, connected rooms looks really bad. She had the perfect opportunity to slip into medbay, take out Frank, and keep moving. 

I'm voting Alice today. It's the only scenario that makes sense with the paths we've shared.

I've already shared my route and observations — I started in security, went to weapons (Charlie was there at ticks 3 and 4), back through security (Charlie still there at tick 6), then through electrical into medbay where I found Frank's body.

Listening to everyone now: Charlie confirms my early movements, which clears us both for the start of the round. Bob and Charlie cross-confirm each other at navigation around tick 10. Diana was on the far left side the whole round in the engines.

That leaves Alice. She admits to passing through cafeteria — which connects directly to medbay — and into electrical, with zero witnesses the entire round. That's the exact path someone would take to slip into medbay, kill Frank, and slip out. Alice, the fact that you're "in electrical now" and didn't see me is consistent with you arriving there AFTER I'd already moved into medbay and found the body — meaning you could have come from medbay yourself.

I'm voting Alice. Her path is the only one that puts her at the scene with no alibi.

I've already shared my route, but to recap: storage → navigation → security, and I saw Charlie at tick 10 in navigation.

Listening to everyone, the picture is getting clearer. Charlie and Eve vouch for each other early. Charlie and I cross at navigation around tick 10. Diana was on the engines side the whole time. That leaves Alice as the only person who moved through the rooms directly adjacent to medbay — cafeteria and electrical — with zero witnesses for her entire route.

Alice, I want to be fair: your story is internally consistent and it's possible you just had unlucky timing. But the path upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → electrical is exactly the route someone would take to dip into medbay and kill Frank without being seen by anyone on the right side of the ship. And Eve makes a good point — if you're in electrical now and didn't see her pass through, you may have arrived there after she'd already moved into medbay.

I'm leaning Alice as well. Unless Alice can give us something more concrete — a task she completed in cafeteria or electrical that we could verify — I'll vote with Charlie, Diana, and Eve.

Hold on — everyone's piling on me, but let's actually think about this carefully.

Yes, my route was upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → electrical. Yes, cafeteria connects to medbay. But here's the thing: if I had ducked into medbay to kill Frank, I would have had to detour off my path, and the timing matters. Eve says she came through electrical into medbay and found the body. I'm in electrical NOW. If I had killed Frank in medbay, why would I then move INTO electrical where Eve was about to come from? That puts me right next to the body just as she's finding it — terrible play for a Duck.

More importantly: Eve says she passed through electrical on her way to medbay. I'm in electrical now and didn't see her. That cuts both ways — either our timings just didn't overlap, OR Eve didn't actually come through electrical. Eve is the one who "found" the body. The reporter is always worth scrutinizing. She had the most direct access to medbay and the cleanest story because Charlie vouches for her EARLY ticks — but Frank was killed later, after she left security.

Charlie vouches for Eve at ticks 3-6. That doesn't cover when Frank actually died. Eve could have killed Frank in medbay and reported it herself.

I'm not saying I'm certain it's Eve, but the rush to vote me when my only "crime" is having no witnesses on the left side of the ship feels like a Duck steering the vote. I'd rather we skip than wrongly eject a Goose. If you won't skip, consider Eve.

Alice, I hear your defense, but it doesn't quite hold up for me. You're trying to flip suspicion onto Eve, but think about it: Eve came from security through electrical into medbay. I confirmed she was in security at tick 6. For her to have killed Frank, she'd have to enter medbay, kill him, and then immediately report — which is possible, sure, but she'd be the obvious suspect, which is exactly why reporters usually aren't the killer unless they have no choice.

Your argument that "moving into electrical after killing in medbay is bad play" actually cuts the other way — it's a natural escape route. Kill in medbay, slip into electrical, act like you just arrived. And the fact that you didn't see Eve in electrical could simply mean she'd already moved into medbay by the time you got there.

The strongest fact remains: you moved through cafeteria and electrical — both directly adjacent to medbay — with zero witnesses the entire round. Everyone else has at least one cross-confirmation. Diana was on the engines side, Bob and I cross at navigation, Eve and I cross early at weapons/security.

I'm voting Alice.

Alice, I understand why you're trying to cast doubt on Eve, but Charlie's logic is just too solid here. Ducking into electrical after a kill in medbay isn't a bad play—it's exactly what you'd do to clear the area and blend back into a normal path. It gives you the exact plausible deniability you're trying to use right now. 

You admit you were in cafeteria, which is right next door to the body, and you've been completely unseen the entire round. Eve and Charlie vouching for each other early on makes Eve a much riskier suspect than you. And as I said earlier, I was nowhere near the center of the ship, having spent the round on the left side in the engines. 

With everyone else having at least partial cross-confirmation, the process of elimination points directly at you. I'm sticking with my vote for Alice; it's the only logical choice we have today.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Hey Bob, heading to lower engine for tasks. Want to buddy up?

I called this meeting because I found Charlie's body in medbay. My route this round was lower engine, up to upper engine, then oxygen, into cafeteria, over to weapons, and back to cafeteria — I passed by medbay area on my way and spotted the body.

The only living players left besides me are Diana and Eve. One of you is the Duck. I saw Charlie alive in navigation back at tick 10, but nothing since.

Diana, Eve — where were you both? Last meeting Eve reported Frank's body and we ejected Alice. If Alice was innocent, then the Duck is still here. Speak up.

I'll share what I know. My route was cafeteria, then oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, and finally navigation where the meeting was called.

I saw Charlie alive early on — tick 3 and 4 in weapons, then tick 6 in security. After that, I never saw him again. The only other player I encountered was Bob — I saw him at tick 18 entering oxygen from upper engine, which matches his stated route.

So Bob's story checks out on that one data point. I was nowhere near medbay this round — my path went through the west and south side of the ship, not the center.

That leaves Diana. Bob, did you actually see Diana anywhere on your route? Because if neither of us saw her, and the body was in medbay, she's looking very suspicious. Diana, we need a detailed route from you.

Eve, I was on the east side of the ship most of this round — I went from Weapons down to Security, into Navigation, and then over to Storage. That's why you didn't see me on your route through the west and south. 

But hold on, look closely at Bob's story. Bob, you just admitted that you "spotted the body" in Medbay, but instead of reporting it directly, you ran all the way to Cafeteria to push the Emergency Button? That makes absolutely zero sense for a Goose. A Goose just reports the body the second they see it. A Duck kills, runs away to distance themselves, and then hits the button to try and control the narrative. 

Eve, Bob completely gave himself away with that slip-up. Why would anyone run away from a body they found just to call a meeting? It has to be Bob. I'm voting him.

Diana, that's a clever spin but it's wrong. I didn't run from medbay to cafeteria to "control the narrative" — I passed by medbay, saw the body, and the call_meeting button is in cafeteria which was right there. Calling a meeting and reporting a body both bring everyone together the same way — there's no Duck advantage to one over the other.

More importantly, let's look at your route: Weapons → Security → Navigation → Storage. That's the east and south side. But medbay is in the CENTER. To get from Security to Navigation you don't pass medbay — fine. But you also could have easily detoured through medbay between any of those moves. And critically, Eve's route through upper engine, lower engine, storage means she would have seen you in storage if you were actually there at the end — Eve, did you see Diana in storage?

Also Diana, you conveniently have zero player sightings. No one saw you, you saw no one. That's the Duck's dream alibi — unverifiable.

Eve confirmed seeing me entering oxygen from upper engine at tick 18, which matches my route exactly. I have a partial alibi. Diana has nothing. I'm voting Diana.

Bob raises a critical point. My route ended at storage right before navigation — I was in storage around tick 26-27. Diana, if you went to storage after navigation as you claim, our paths should have crossed or been very close in time. But I saw no one in storage. That's a problem for your story.

Also, Diana, your accusation against Bob is weak. "Why didn't he report instead of call meeting" — they functionally do the same thing, and cafeteria is adjacent to medbay. That's not a gotcha, that's a stretch.

Meanwhile, Bob's alibi has one concrete confirmation from me — tick 18, oxygen, entering from upper engine, exactly as he said. Diana has zero corroboration and her route conveniently avoids being seen by anyone.

Last meeting we ejected Alice on my report and clearly got it wrong since the killing continued. I don't want to make that mistake twice — but the evidence here points to Diana. She had opportunity (could easily detour through medbay), no witnesses, and her attack on Bob is based on flawed reasoning.

I'm voting Diana.

Eve, please think about this for a second before you lock in your vote. Bob being in Oxygen at tick 18 means absolutely nothing regarding Charlie's death because Charlie was ALIVE long after that. 

I actually saw Charlie alive in Medbay around tick 26, right before I headed out. Bob's exact stated route is that he went from Weapons back to Cafeteria and then "passed by Medbay" and spotted the body. That perfectly lines up with Bob walking in and killing Charlie right after I left the area! If I had killed him at tick 26, why wouldn't I just self-report right then instead of leaving the body for Bob to conveniently find and hit the button? 

Bob is using a completely irrelevant tick 18 alibi to manipulate you into covering his late-round kill. If you vote me, he wins. Please, vote Bob.
